scope: Targeted lifetime/cancellation review and regressions by the implementation agent; not an independent or completed protocol audit

findings.before: A request approved after its session expired still dispatched one execution in both regression fixtures. The request itself had not expired, and an affirmative approval was still required.
findings.repair: Pass the owning session expiry into authorization and check the earlier of the session and request deadlines before review, approval and execution.
findings.after: Both regressions finish with zero executions.

findings.before: A task cancelled while awaiting approval still dispatched one execution in the regression fixture.
findings.repair: Check cooperative task cancellation at authorizer entry and after review/approval, and before further session transport work.
findings.after: CancellationError is propagated by the standalone authorizer; zero executions.

limits: An execution already dispatched to an adapter cannot be retracted by the transport. Adapters must check wallet lock/cancellation before accessing keys and handle ambiguous broadcasts without automatic retry.
